name: filesystem-streamable-http
description: A local Streamable-HTTP endpoint produced by deploy-mcp.sh bridging the official filesystem stdio server. Start it first with './example/deploy-mcp.sh filesystem start --path <dir>' (listens on 127.0.0.1:8002/mcp/filesystem by default); this record also needs egress_allowlist to permit the loopback address before agenthub can probe and call it. Optional seed entry: loaded by default from load.sh.

metadata.install: Run ./example/deploy-mcp.sh filesystem start --path <dir> first (default port 8002, path /mcp/filesystem)
